Illustrations by OpenMoji · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Reinterpreted as ASCII.


  
HELLO, WORLD.
All you need is a character.
A little tribute to text files, late-night forums, and the beautifully inventive world of early internet art. Inspired by ASCII Art from GameFAQs by Lock Books.
[01] START WITH SOMETHING
Describe a subject to find it in the OpenMoji illustration library. For people, landmarks, or other subjects, switch to online photo search. You can also combine library subjects with “and.”
[02] FIND ITS CHARACTER
Each image becomes a grid of text. Adjust the detail, character set, and contrast to find the right texture. Upload your own image for a specific scene or composition.
[03] TAKE IT WITH YOU
Copy it into a text file, or download a TXT, PNG, or SVG. Use a monospace font to keep everything lined up.
This is a library and image converter, not an AI image model. Online search sends your search terms to Wikipedia. Uploaded images are processed only on your device. OpenMoji-derived art is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; exported files include attribution. Online photos retain their original licenses.
